title: PUT /v1/github-identities/{id} request
description: Store a version of an identity record (expected_version 0 creates it): owner = the caller (sealed under the caller's CK) or an organization the caller is an admin of (sealed under a fresh epoch of the organization's credential key whose only readers are its devices, with `key`; author = the caller) (03-api.md section 4.8, ADR-076 section 1).

key.description: company records only (owner an organization): the new epoch of the organization's credential key (current + 1) created for this write and its wraps for every reader device (active member devices assigned to a workgroup of the organization); admins seal each version under a fresh key and cannot read it back (ADR-076 section 1, key model KM-35)
